items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: I walked in and I said, how do you do, sir? ... Mr. Garnier said, no, I don't have no printer here, no.

ctx.x: How many of you are in New Orleans? Yeah.

So I walked up Rampart Street one day after I bought my first new suit after getting out of the service. Born Art Clothing Store. You know where Born Art is there. And, uh... And I got on the other side of just a little up from Poitras. And, uh, I saw this printing office. Allies Printery. And the door was open. A young lady was sitting behind the desk. Her name was Mary Dupree. And, uh, an elderly, stoop-shouldered white man was at the desk and he was covering some papers. And so I just forced myself. I walked…
I said, the case here, you have to find a type.
